{{Quote|I have failed in my duty, and I expect to be executed soon. With this record, history will perhaps judge me more kindly.|Ergric Betos|<ref name="Royalty and Rebellion" />}}
'''Ergric Betos''' was the bodyguard of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Anod]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]] around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. He witnessed the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Anod at the hands of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent, [[Zeta Traal]] but failed to stop it in time. In his attempt to avenge his fallen charge, he saw the deranged [[Velmoc]] [[Jedidiah]] save the life of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] by diving in front of a blast meant for the Rebel. He was also witness to the [[Regent/Legends|Lord Regent]], [[Zelor]]'s attempt on Skywalker's life, and his death at Skywalker's hands. Following these events, he returned to [[Den Velmor]], and accepted responsibility for the death of Anod. The new [[King/Legends|King]] [[Denid]] exiled the failed bodyguard to the [[Tol Velmoc mountains]], where he eventually became an honored member of the [[Velmoc-Dac]] tribe.
